query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM team_members tm
                INNER JOIN mods m ON m.team_id = tm.team_id
                WHERE tm.user_id = $1
                    AND tm.accepted
                    AND m.components ? 'shop'
                    AND (m.components -> 'shop' ->> 'season')::int = (
                        SELECT MAX(id) FROM seasons WHERE started_at <= NOW()
                    )
            ) AS "exists!"
